title: The Moralization Corpus: Frame-Based Annotation and Analysis of Moralizing Speech Acts across Diverse Text Genres
reasoning: The paper develops a frame-based annotation scheme and dataset (The Moralization Corpus) to analyze moralizing language. It categorizes moral values based on the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) and benchmarks various LLMs on their ability to detect and extract moral values, demands, and protagonists from text, thereby directly evaluating moral reasoning and ethical content handling.
